findings.desc: quality-fail-closed: packages/main/src/handlers/certification-window.ts:87-102 collectAdmitFacts catch blocks set missingRequiredIntents=0 and openBlockingFindingIds=[] when coverage or finding/policy reads throw, so certification_window_begin can ADMIT. The same function fail-closes an unreadable dirty-tree classifier. PRE_CERT admit must refuse when required facts cannot be computed.

quality-fail-closed: packages/main/src/core/certification-window.ts:266 windowAuthorizesHeavyCertification(window, null) returns Boolean(window.receiptId). loadVerifiedCertificationWindow:653-654 only verifies a receipt when one is found, so deleting receipts[] from certification-window.json while leaving a signed ADMITTED window+receiptId still authorizes done_required_validate / validate --full. A missing PRE_CERT receipt must fail closed.

quality-fail-closed: packages/main/src/core/certification-window.ts:675-679 detectCertificationWindowMaterialDrift treats undefined current storyFilesHash/materialHash as no drift. currentMaterialHash/currentStoryFilesHash return undefined on git failure, so refresh/heavy keep an ADMITTED or RUNNING window live instead of invalidating. Unreadable frozen identity is not fail-closed.

quality-cleanup: packages/main/src/handlers/certification-window.ts:43-48 persistHint swallows autoCommitStoryMetadata errors with an empty catch and returns empty string. Persist failures are PERSIST-class and must reportHealthIssue, not stay silent. A failed metadata commit after begin/cancel leaves a dirty unsigned window with no health trace.

packages/main/src/tasks/certification-window-smoke.ts:683-688 CHK-004:test-or-verifier-mutation-invalidates is a must edge intent (material write to test or verifier inputs invalidates ADMITTED/RUNNING) but the pinned invalidation smoke only commits src/app.ts and then asserts State: INVALIDATED. currentCertificationIdentity always hardcodes PRECERT_VERIFIER_IDENTITY/PRECERT_TEST_IDENTITY (handlers/certification-window.ts:145-146), so the verifier/test identity-drift branch in detectCertificationWindowMaterialDrift (core/certification-window.ts:681-694) is never executed. Evidence note 'material change invalidates at next status' does not correspond to the test/verifier discriminator. high

packages/main/src/tasks/certification-window-smoke.ts:642-696 CHK-004:no-cross-story-dev-lock is a must adversarial intent (another story DEV write/commit in its own worktree succeeds; this window takes no repo-wide write lock; consumers persist INVALIDATED even if status was never called). The pinned invalidation/replay smoke never creates a second story or worktree, never attempts a foreign DEV commit, and never asserts the absence of a long-lived repo lock. Its evidence selector is only State: INVALIDATED from the same B-cw21 source commit, so the lock/isolation claim is uncovered. high
